item.title: San Diego committee to revisit vacancy tax proposal introduced by council member
item.description: A proposed tax on vacant homes in San Diego will be back on the table this week as the City of San Diego's rules committee decides whether to include it on the June ballot.

item.title: San Diego airport new program for travelers with disabilities
item.description: San Diego International Airport has launched SAN Assist, a new assistance program for travelers with non-visible disabilities.

item.title: Navy police officer in court for I-8 crash that killed 2, including La Mesa police officer
item.description: The Navy police officer who was arrested for his role in a crash that killed a La Mesa police officer and a 19-year-old man on Interstate 8 last October appeared in court Tuesday morning for a readiness conference.

item.title: San Diego Chaldean bishop accused of embezzlement, brothel visits
item.description: The San Diego Sheriff's Fraud Unit is investigating allegations of financial mishandling against Chaldean Bishop Emanuel Shaleta. The Vatican has started its own investigation for allegations of personal misconduct.

item.title: Miramar National Cemetery unveils new amphitheater
item.description: The Miramar National Cemetery in San Diego has completed construction of a 500-seat Memorial Amphitheatre.

item.title: Lawsuit alleges Campbell’s of worker misclassification
item.description: The Campbell's Company is being sued for allegedly misclassifying workers and violating state law by using a "direct-store-delivery" model for workers who stock merchandise on retail shelves, which excludes them of minimum wage, overtime pay, and other benefits.

item.title: San Diego settles with insurers, flood victims still unpaid
item.description: The City of San Diego approved a $6.3 million settlement to seventeen insurance companies over the January 2024 floods, leaving many victims frustrated that the insurance companies got paid first.

item.title: Clairemont High School mascot gets rebrand
item.description: Clairemont High School in San Diego has replaced its mascot, the Chieftains, with the Captains, after a law was passed prohibiting the use of derogatory Native American terms as school names or mascots.

item.title: San Diego Navy vet awarded Medal of Honor by Trump
item.description: President Donald Trump delivered his State of the Union address, awarding the Congressional Medal of Honor to retired Navy Captain Royce Williams.
